name: Order Tracking
description: Live shipment tracking timeline, courier information, and customer order status progression updates.
author: Nasrify Core

enablePublicTracking.label: Enable Public Tracking
enablePublicTracking.description: Allow customers to track order progress on /track-order without requiring an account login

enableAutoNotifications.label: Auto Status Notifications
enableAutoNotifications.description: Automatically send notifications to customers when fulfillment status changes

showCourierField.label: Show Courier Details
showCourierField.description: Display courier name and tracking code in the shipment progress timeline

showTimeline.label: Show Visual Timeline
showTimeline.description: Display the visual step-by-step progress timeline on the tracking page

timelineStages.label: Timeline Stages
timelineStages.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment stages displayed on customer tracking timelines

estimatedDeliveryDays.label: Default Estimated Delivery Days
estimatedDeliveryDays.description: Default delivery timeframe (in days) calculated for new orders
